The last message that is not a system status line - the guest's words or answer ("late 15"), or the venue's - what the
row previews, with `answer` on an answer and `staffName` on a venue message.

latestStatus.description: The newest system status line in the thread ("held until 19:45", "cancelled"), or absent.

unreadFromGuest.description: What the guest wrote since anybody at the venue last read it - typed messages and answers.

awaitingGuestAnswer.description: The last message is the venue's "are you coming?" and the guest has not answered.

oldestUnansweredGuestMessageUtc.description:
The first typed guest message since the venue last wrote - the one to remind about after `remindAfterMinutes`.
A guest's answer to "are you coming?" asks nothing back and never counts. Absent when nothing waits, and once the
thread has closed - nobody can answer it any more.

Yalla.Application.Messages.InboxItem.description: One thread on the tablet's Messages tab.

id.description: The booking's or the order's id.

label.description: The table's label for a booking, the code ("T-485") for an order.

localTime.description: A booking's start or an order's ready time, `HH:mm` on the branch's clock.

localDate.description: A booking's day, `yyyy-MM-dd`. Absent on an order.

partySize.description: A booking's party. Absent on an order.

itemCount.description: An order's dishes in all. Absent on a booking.

totalAmd.description: An order's total, to pay at pickup. Absent on a booking.

Yalla.Application.Messages.InboxSubject.description: A thread's subject on the tablet's inbox row.

Yalla.Application.Messages.MessageAnswer.description: The guest's answer to "are you coming?".

messageCount.description: The guest's and the venue's messages - the system's status lines are not counted.

firstAtUtc.description: When the first message still in the thread was written.

lastAtUtc.description: When the last was - the row's "when", and the order of the list.

lastLocal.description: The same instant on the branch's clock, `yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm`.

staffNames.description: Who at the venue wrote, as they were named then - each once, in the order they first wrote.

unanswered.description: The guest's last typed message has no venue message after it.

open.description: The thread still takes messages - from the tablet; nobody answers from here.

Yalla.Application.Messages.MessageHistor.description: One thread on the console's Messages page.

nextCursor.description: Pass back as `cursor` for the next page; absent on the last.

from.description: The first date the page was read for - the default filled in when none was sent.

Yalla.Application.Messages.MessageHistor.description: A page of the branch's message history, newest last message first.

id.description: The booking's or the order's id - the thread's route.

label.description: The table's label for a booking, the code ("T-485") for an order.

guestName.description: The guest, as the booking or order names them.

localDate.description: A booking's day, or an order's ready day, `yyyy-MM-dd` on the branch's clock.

localTime.description: A booking's start, or an order's ready time, `HH:mm` on the branch's clock.

partySize.description: A booking's party. Absent on an order.

itemCount.description: An order's dishes in all. Absent on a booking.

totalAmd.description: An order's total. Absent on a booking.

outcome.description:
What became of it. A booking: `came`, `no-show`, `cancelled`, `declined` or `upcoming`. An
order: `collected`, `no-show`, `declined`, `cancelled` or `in-progress`.

Yalla.Application.Messages.MessageHistor.description: A thread's subject on a history row.

Yalla.Application.Messages.MessageSettin.description: The bounds of the message settings, and of a message.

guestsCanWrite.description: Guests may type messages. Default true.

templates.description: The quick replies; absent for the app's default set.

remindAfterMinutes.description: The tablet rings after this long unanswered. Default 3.

Yalla.Application.Messages.MessageSettin.description: The branch's message settings with their bounds.

heldUntilLocal.description: After `late`: the start plus the minutes, `HH:mm` on the branch's clock. Absent otherwise.

cancelled.description: True after `not-coming`: the booking was cancelled.

Yalla.Application.Messages.MessageStatus.description: What the booking is after the guest's answer - the system line "Booking updated · held until 19:45".

unread.description: What the venue wrote since the guest last read the thread - "1 new".

lastAuthor.description: `guest`, `venue` or `system`; absent while nobody has written.

lastKind.description: `text`, `ask-coming`, `answer` or `status`; absent while nobody has written.

lastText.description: The last message's words when it is a `text`, at most 140 characters. Absent otherwise.

lastAtUtc.description: When the last message was written; absent while nobody has written.

Yalla.Application.Messages.MessagesSumma.description:
A thread in one line, on a booking (list and detail) and on an Orders-tab takeaway order - the "Messages with the
venue" card. Absent when the subject has no thread and takes none.

text.description: The words of a `text` message. Absent for the other kinds.

status.description: A `status` line's facts.

staffName.description: On a venue message: who wrote it, as they were named then. Absent on the others.

Yalla.Application.Messages.StaffConversa.description: One message as the venue sees it: the guest's view plus who at the venue wrote it.

conversationId.description: The thread; absent while nobody has written yet.

guestName.description: The guest, as the booking or order names them.

guestPhone.description:
The guest's number as the booking or order holds it, for the Call button - never shown in the thread itself. Empty for
a platform admin: the venue's to call, as on the takeaway counter and the pre-order rail.

closesAtUtc.description: When it closes, or closed. Absent while a takeaway order is still moving.

guestsCanWrite.description: Whether the guest may type (the venue's setting).

canWrite.description:
The caller may write here now: the thread is open and they are a manager, the general manager or the owner - or a
waiter while the venue lets waiters write. Never a platform admin, never the kitchen.

pendingAsk.description: The venue asked "are you coming?" and the guest has not answered, while the answer is still taken.

venueLastReadUtc.description: When anybody at the venue last read it.

guestLastReadUtc.description: When the guest last read it: a venue message not after it is "seen".

unreadCount.description: What the guest wrote since the venue last read the thread.

Yalla.Application.Messages.StaffConversa.description: A thread as the venue reads it: the guest's view, plus who wrote each venue message and whether the caller may write.

conversationId.description: The thread - made by this message when it was the first.

text.description: What was stored: the text trimmed.

wasReplay.description: The same `clientCommandId` wrote it before: nothing new was written, nobody told twice.

Yalla.Application.Messages.StaffMessageR.description: The answer to staff's send: the message as written, with who wrote it.

type.description: What it was, e.g. `reservation.reminder`.

idempotencyKey.description: What caused it - this names the booking or the tab.

attemptCount.description: How many times it was tried before being given up on.

deadLetteredAtUtc.description: When it was given up on.

lastError.description: Why. The first thing to read.

Yalla.Application.Messaging.DeadLetterVi.description: One message nobody is going to retry.

pending.description: Written, not yet sent, not dead. Includes ones not yet due.

due.description: Pending and due now - the backlog, if there is one.

failed.description: Pending with at least one failed attempt behind them.

deadLettered.description: Given up on. These need a person.

sentLastDay.description: Sent in the last twenty-four hours, so "nothing is sending" is visible.

deadLetters.description: The dead-lettered messages themselves, newest first.

deadLetteredLastDay.description:
Given up on in the last twenty-four hours: the messages that recently failed to reach somebody, which
is what the console's Home alert counts. DeadLettered is every one ever.

Yalla.Application.Messaging.OutboxHealth.description: What the platform view shows about the outbox.

locale.description: The language pushes are written in (`hy`, `ru`, `en`); absent means Armenian.

subscribed.description: This device has a push subscription on file.

isDefault.description: Nothing was chosen yet: these are the defaults for the device and its person's role.

Yalla.Application.Notifications.StaffNot.description: A device's notification settings as the staff app's switches show them: the six switches, flat.

enabled.description: False when no VAPID keys are configured: pushes are logged, not sent - offer no switch.

publicKey.description:
The VAPID public key, base64url - `applicationServerKey` for `pushManager.subscribe`. When it differs from
the one the browser's subscription was made with, unsubscribe and subscribe again (a Development server makes a
new one every start). Absent when disabled.

Yalla.Application.Notifications.StaffPus.description: Whether this server sends Web Push, and the key a browser subscribes with.

tabOrderLineId.description: The line it applies to, or null for the whole tab.

kind.description: Why money is coming off a bill.

percent.description: Percentage off, when that is how it was expressed.

amountAmd.description: Flat dram off, when that is how it was expressed.

What it actually took off, in whole dram: its own reduction worked out in the bill's order (a line's own adjustments
before the tab-wide ones) - the amount the History and the reports give it. Not the subtotal's drop, which under a
standing tab-wide discount is less than a line's comp took. Zero once reversed.

reason.description: Why. Shown to the diner for the same reason a void is.

isVoided.description: True once reversed. It stays on the record either way.

Yalla.Application.Ordering.AdjustmentVie.description: An adjustment as the diner sees it, reason included.

amountAmd.description: What was taken against the balance.

tipAmd.description: The tip, which is not part of the balance.

status.description: Lifecycle of a payment attempt.

tabParticipantId.description: Who handed it over, when known.

tabClosed.description: True when this payment settled the bill and closed the tab.

tableSessionClosed.description: True when closing the tab also closed the sitting. The table is not freed by this - that stays an explicit waiter action, because physical and financial state are independent.

tabEventSequence.description: The tab's event sequence after this payment.

wasReplay.description: True when the command had already been applied.

orderId.description: The order. For a booking's pre-order, the pre-order's id - the same before and after the party sits.

tabId.description: Its tab. Absent on a pre-order sent before the party sat: a held ticket, cooked ahead, on no bill until they arrive - it then reappears under the same OrderId with the tab.

tableLabel.description: Which table to take it to.

status.description: Kitchen-facing progress of one order placed against a tab.

waitingMinutes.description: How long it has been waiting, at the moment of reading.

lines.description: What to cook, with the kitchen notes.

placedByName.description: Who sent it: the waiter's name as the staff sign-in roster shows it, when a waiter keyed it in. Absent when a diner ordered from their own phone - the ticket then says it came from the app. Read as the staff member is now: a rename shows, and a waiter no longer active still sent it.

preOrder.description:
Set when this is a booking's pre-order - held or on the tab it became: whose, and when they are due, so the kitchen
times the cooking. Absent on every other order.

takeaway.description:
Set when this is a takeaway order the venue accepted - the "TAKEAWAY" band: its code, when it is promised, whose it
is and the guest's note. TableLabel is the code, TabId is absent, and the
kitchen's "Ready" is `POST /api/takeaway-orders/{orderId}/ready`. Absent on every other order.

Yalla.Application.Ordering.KitchenOrderV.description: An order on the kitchen queue.

localStartTime.description: The same, on the branch's wall clock - "pre-order for 19:30".

guestName.description: Who booked - a name, never a number.

Yalla.Application.Ordering.KitchenPreOrd.description: The booking a kitchen ticket was pre-ordered for.

code.description: "T-482" - what the guest says at the counter.

readyAtLocalTime.description: The same, on the branch's wall clock - "ready 19:10".

guestName.description: Whose it is - a name, never a number.

note.description: The guest's note: "no onion, separate bag". Absent when none.

Yalla.Application.Ordering.KitchenTakeaw.description: The takeaway order a kitchen ticket is.

name.description: The name snapshotted at order time.

unitPriceAmd.description: The price snapshotted at order time.

lineTotalAmd.description: Unit price times quantity. Zero once voided.

isTableAttributed.description: Nobody owns it: the waiter could not say who ordered it.

note.description: The kitchen note.

sharedWithParticipantIds.description: Who it splits across, snapshotted at order time.

onBehalfOfParticipantId.description:
Who a waiter keyed this line in for: the line's own `participantId` when one was sent,
otherwise the order's `onBehalfOfParticipantId`. Null on a diner's own order (the line is
the orderer's), when the waiter named nobody, and on a shared line, which is the table's.

Yalla.Application.Ordering.OrderLineView.description: One line as it was placed, for the order confirmation and the kitchen queue.

status.description: Kitchen-facing progress of one order placed against a tab.

placedByParticipantId.description: The diner who ordered from their phone.

placedByStaffId.description: The waiter who keyed it in.

onBehalfOfParticipantId.description: Who a spoken order was for, when the waiter knew.

estimatedReadyAtUtc.description: From the longest prep time on the order, not the sum: a kitchen cooks an order together.

tableTotalVisible.description:
Whether Totals is present: for staff, and for a diner allowed the table total -
the rule `tableTotalVisible` on their tab follows.

totals.description: The tab's totals as they stand after this order. Absent for a diner the host hid the total from - an order of their own is no way round the hidden bill. Never zeroed.

tabEventSequence.description: The tab's event sequence after this order, for a live client.

wasReplay.description: True when the command had already been applied and this is the original answer.

Yalla.Application.Ordering.OrderView.description: An order as it was accepted.

status.description: Whether a participant is allowed on the tab.

sharedItemsAmd.description: Their slice of shared and table-attributed lines.

absorbedFromRemovedAmd.description:
What fell to them because somebody removed from the tab cannot pay for what they ate. Non-zero
only for the host, and stated rather than folded in silently.

serviceChargeAmd.description: Their pro-rata slice of the service charge.

shareAmd.description: What they owe. These sum to the tab total exactly.

paidAmd.description: What they have settled. Reported, never netted off the share.

Yalla.Application.Ordering.ParticipantSh.description: What one person owes. See `docs/billing.md` for the arithmetic.

preset.description: What a table is asking for. Presets only - see `docs/tabs.md`.

note.description: The one optional line.

waitingMinutes.description: How long they have been waiting.

acknowledgedAtUtc.description: When a waiter picked it up, if they have.

tabEventSequence.description:
Where the tab's event stream stands. Raising or acknowledging a request appends an event, so the
response says where that left the stream - otherwise the phone that just called a waiter is the
one client guaranteed to be behind. Zero on the branch-wide list, which spans many tabs and so
has no single stream to be caught up with.

billScope.description:
On a request for the bill that said whose part: 1 WholeBill, 2 MyShare. Absent on every other
request.

billAmountAmd.description:
What that scope left to pay when the diner asked, in whole dram - service charge included, tip
excluded. Priced by the server, so the waiter brings the number the diner was shown. Absent with
BillScope.

tipPercent.description: The tip the diner chose, 0 to 25. Absent when none was asked.

tipAmd.description:
That tip in whole dram, on top of BillAmountAmd and outside the bill, like a
cash payment's `tipAmd`. Absent with TipPercent.

acknowledgedByStaffMemberId.description: Who acknowledged it. Absent while nobody has.

acknowledgedByName.description: That waiter's name as stored now. Absent with the id.

claimedAtUtc.description: When a waiter said "I'm on it" (`claimServiceRequest`); absent while nobody has.

claimedByStaffMemberId.description: Who - the first to claim it.

claimedByName.description: Their name as stored now, for "Aram is on it".

maxSequence.description: The newest position on the tab, whether or not it is in this page.

hasMore.description: True when more remain past this page.

Yalla.Application.Ordering.TabEventPage.description: A page of a tab's event stream.

sequence.description: This event's place on its tab, from 1. Ask for everything after the one you hold.

type.description: What happened on a tab, for the catch-up stream.

actorId.description: Who, when there is a who.

Yalla.Application.Ordering.TabEventView.description: One thing that happened on a tab.

myShare.description: The caller's own share. Always present.

tableTotalVisible.description: Whether the two members below are present.

totals.description: The table aggregate. Absent when not visible.

shares.description: Everyone's share. Absent when not visible.

absorbedFromRemovedAmd.description: How much fell to the host from removed participants.

maxSequence.description:
Where the tab's event stream stands, so a client that just read the split knows whether it has
missed anything. Prompt 8 said every tab response carries it; this one did not, which made the
bill screen - the screen where being out of date matters most - the one that had to ask twice.

Yalla.Application.Ordering.TabSharesView.description: Who owes what on a tab, projected through the caller's own visibility.

Yalla.Application.Ordering.TabTotalsSnap.description: The tab's money, in whole dram. Server-computed; a client only ever displays it.

timeZoneId.description: The branch's IANA zone, which every local value here is in.

asOfUtc.description: The instant the numbers are true of - the screen's "updated at".

localDate.description: The calendar date at the branch now.

localTime.description: The branch's wall clock at Yalla.Application.Overview.BranchOverview.AsOfUtc, whole seconds.

serviceDate.description:
The service day everything here is about: Yalla.Application.Overview.BranchOverview.LocalDate, or the day before while last night's
block is still open.

graceMinutes.description: How long past its start the branch holds a late party's table (the policy's grace).

hours.description: Whether the branch is open now, and until or from when.

bookings.description: The service day's bookings, counted by status.

openTabs.description: The bills still open, and what they still owe.

revenue.description: The service day's takings so far against the same point a week before.

load.description: Booked people per hour of the service day, against the room's seats.

todayBookings.description:
The service day's bookings one by one, earliest first, leaving out the cancelled and declined ones; at
most `200`.

todayBookingsTruncated.description: More bookings than the list carries: the counts and the chart still have them all.

Yalla.Application.Overview.BranchOvervie.description: The venue console's Overview of one branch, today: what is booked, who is in, what is owed, what came in.

code.description: Its door code.

status.description: Lifecycle of a booking. Every member is the result of somebody doing something.

localDate.description: The start's calendar date: the service date, or the next for a sitting after midnight.

localStartTime.description: The start on the branch's clock.

tableId.description: The table - what `seat-reservation` and `free` are addressed by.

tableStatus.description: The physical state of a table: what somebody did to it.

roomName.description: The room the table is in, when it is in one.

channel.description: Where a booking was made from.

changeRequested.description:
A confirmed booking whose change is waiting for an answer: the start, table and party here are the slot
still promised, and the change is in the approvals list. Its status is `PendingApproval`, so the
floor's actions on it wait for that answer.

holdExpiresAtUtc.description: While the booking is confirmed and its table held for a late party: until when.

lateNudgeAtUtc.description:
While the booking is confirmed: when the app asked, or will ask, the guest whether they are still coming -
the nudge as it stands in the outbox, its send time once sent. Absent when none is scheduled.

lateNudgeSent.description: With LateNudgeAtUtc: whether it has gone out.

guestRecord.description:
The guest's record over the last twelve months at every venue; absent when no verified account is behind the
booking. See Yalla.Application.Reservations.GuestRecord.

Yalla.Application.Overview.OverviewBooki.description: One of the service day's bookings, as the Overview's table lists it.

total.description: Every booking still on the books: pending, confirmed, seated, completed and no-shows - not the cancelled or declined.

pendingApproval.description: Requests waiting for an answer, that have no confirmed slot today to fall back to.

confirmed.description:
Promised and not yet seated - the late ones included, and a confirmed booking whose change is waiting
(Yalla.Application.Overview.OverviewBookingCounts.PendingChanges), counted at the slot it still holds.

late.description: Of Yalla.Application.Overview.OverviewBookingCounts.Confirmed, those whose start has passed.

cancelled.description: Called off by the diner or the venue, declined requests included.

people.description: The party sizes of the pending, confirmed, seated and completed.

pendingChanges.description: Of Yalla.Application.Overview.OverviewBookingCounts.Confirmed, those with a change waiting for an answer.

cancelledBySystem.description:
Of Yalla.Application.Overview.OverviewBookingCounts.Cancelled, those the platform cancelled - their guest was blocked for no-shows - and not the
venue or the guest.

Yalla.Application.Overview.OverviewBooki.description: The service day's bookings by status.

isOpen.description: Inside an opening block now - today's, or last night's that runs past midnight.

closesAt.description: While open: when the current block closes. Absent while shut.

closesNextDay.description:
While open: the close falls after midnight tonight, so it reads "(next day)". False for a block closing
at 00:00 - "until 00:00" - and for last night's block, which closes today.

opensAt.description: While shut: the next opening later today. Absent when open, or when nothing opens later today.

specialDay.description:
The service date's special opening day - a holiday, a closure, different hours - when it has one; absent on an
ordinary day. Everything above already reads it.

Yalla.Application.Overview.OverviewHours.description: The header's "open until" line, from the weekly hours.

capacity.description: Seats at the active tables in service - the chart's "the room is full" line.

hours.description:
One entry per hour, contiguous and earliest first, numbered from midnight starting the service date:
0 to 23 on that date, then 24 for 00:00-01:00 of the next, 25 for 01:00 and so on - label an hour
`hour % 24`. From the first opening (or the first booking, if earlier) to the last hour the branch
is open (or the last booked hour, if later). Empty when the branch is shut all day and nothing is booked.

Yalla.Application.Overview.OverviewLoad.description: The load chart: booked people per hour of the service day, against the room.

hour.description: The hour from the service date's midnight: 0 to 23, then 24 onwards past midnight.

people.description: Confirmed, seated and completed parties whose sitting touches this hour.

pendingPeople.description: Requests not yet answered whose sitting touches this hour.

Yalla.Application.Overview.OverviewLoadH.description: One bar of the load chart.

unpaidAmd.description: What they still owe, in whole dram: the server's own `RemainingAmd`, summed.

lastWeekAmd.description: Closed from the same opening seven days before, for as long on the clock.

lastWeekDate.description: The service day a week before.

changePercent.description: The change, to one decimal. Absent when last week took nothing.

sinceUtc.description:
Where the service day's takings start: its first opening (the first block on the service date), or local
midnight of the service date when it has no hours.

Yalla.Application.Overview.OverviewReven.description:
The service day's takings so far, and the same weekday's a week before up to the same point - so 18:42 on
a Saturday is compared with 18:42 the Saturday before, and 01:00 on Sunday with 01:00 the Sunday before.

people.description: The party sizes of the sittings still open.

occupiedTables.description: Active tables somebody is sitting at.

tables.description: Active tables, whatever their state - out of service included.

role.description: Their role when they acted: 5 is the platform admin, the rest a venue's own staff.

displayName.description: Their name when they acted; absent for a row from before names were kept.

action.description:
The stable slug - `venue.create`, `venue.update`, `venue.suspend`,
`venue.reactivate`, `venue.delete`, `branch.create`, `branch.update`,
`branch.features-change` (and, before 2026-10-27, `branch.tier-change`), `venue.features-apply`,
`branch.relocate`, `staff.create`, `staff.sign-in-issued`,
`staff.phone-pairing-issued`, `staff.phone-unpaired`,
`venue.restore`, `review.hide`, `review.unhide`, `review.dismiss-reports`,
`review.restore-reports`, `review.remove-reply` (the platform taking a venue's reply down - a
venue's own replies and removals are left out of the feed), `table.regenerate-qr`,
`admin.rename`, `admin.password-change`, and a venue user's own `account.rename`,
`account.password-change`, `account.sign-out-others`.

actor.description: Who did it, as they were called then.

target.description: What it was done to, as it was called then.

venue.description: The venue it concerns, by its current name; absent for the admin's own account.

detail.description: The row's JSON as written - its shape is per action (docs/platform-admin.md).

Yalla.Application.Platform.ActivityEntry.description: One audit row as the console's activity feed shows it.

Yalla.Application.Platform.ActivityFeed.description: The newest audit rows, newest first.

type.description: `Venue`, `Branch`, `StaffMember`, `BranchReview`, `DiningTable`.

displayName.description:
Its name then - a table's label, a person's name; for a review, the branch it is about, because the
reviewer is a diner and is not named in the log.

upcoming.description: Confirmed and not seated - still ahead, or late and not yet marked.

pendingApproval.description: Still waiting for the venue to approve.

cancelled.description: Cancelled by either side, rejections included.

Yalla.Application.Platform.BookingStatus.description: Bookings by outcome. See Yalla.Application.Platform.BookingBucket for which statuses each counts.

todayCount.description: Bookings for the branch's today, cancelled ones left out - the venue page's branch table.

Yalla.Application.Platform.BranchBooking.description: One branch's share of the window, and its bookings today.

slug.description: URL segment, unique within the venue.

timeZoneId.description: IANA zone; every local time at the branch is in it.

isActive.description: Whether the branch is switched on.

features.description:
The features the platform allows there, in numeric order: 1 AppBookings, 2 WebBookings, 3 PreOrders, 4 Takeaway,
5 TableService, 6 GuestMessages, 7 Reviews, 8 StaffPhone, 9 KitchenDisplay, 10 Reports. The owner's own switches
work inside it. Set with `PUT /api/platform/branches/{id}/features`.

tableCount.description: Active tables. A table kept only for its history is not counted.

openTabCount.description: Tabs open or closing at the branch right now.

district.description: As the listing form saved it.

Yalla.Application.Platform.BranchSummary.description: One branch as the platform's venue page shows it.

slug.description: URL segment, unique within the venue.

features.description:
The features the platform allows there. Absent is the Basic preset - everything but table service (5). Pre-orders
(3) need app (1) or web (2) bookings.

Yalla.Application.Platform.CreateBranchC.description: Add a branch. Features are per branch - a chain with four locations is four customers.

type.description: What kind of place a venue is. Drives the shipped reservation-policy defaults.

firstBranch.description: Add a branch. Features are per branch - a chain with four locations is four customers.

Yalla.Application.Platform.CreateVenueCo.description: Create a venue together with its first branch. A venue with no branch is useless.

issues.description:
What a guest would find missing (M:Yalla.Application.Platform.PlatformRollups.GuestFacingIssues(System.Collections.Generic.IEnumerable{Yalla.Application.BranchSettings.ReadinessIssue},System.Boolean)): `no-tables`,
`no-menu`, `incomplete-dishes`, `no-hours`, `no-photo`. The card shows the first.

Yalla.Application.Platform.NotReadyBranc.description: A branch that is not ready, and why.

last7Days.description: Today and the six days before it.

changePercent.description:
Last7Days against Previous7Days, in percent to one decimal;
            absent when the previous week had none.

labelTimeZoneId.description:
The zone the Yalla.Application.Platform.DailyCount.Date labels are written in: the one most branches share. Each
branch is counted on its own calendar, aligned so the last entry is every branch's today.

perDay.description: Thirty entries, oldest first, the last one today. The 14-day chart is the last fourteen.

Yalla.Application.Platform.OverviewBooki.description:
Bookings by the day of the visit. A booking counts on the branch's own local date; cancelled ones
are left out (a request the venue rejected is a cancellation). Venues that are deleted are left out.

branches.description: The first twenty, by venue name then branch name.

Yalla.Application.Platform.OverviewNotRe.description: The branches still not ready for diners.

pending.description: Written, not yet sent, not dead.

failed.description: Pending with at least one failed attempt.

deadLetteredLastDay.description: Given up on in the last 24 hours - what Home's alert counts.

venues.description: Each venue with any, the most first, then by name.

Yalla.Application.Platform.OverviewVenue.description: A total and the venues it is made of.

deleted.description: Soft-deleted - outside every other number here.

branches.description: Branches of the venues in Total.

Yalla.Application.Platform.OverviewVenue.description: Venue counts. Everything but Deleted counts venues that are not deleted.

fullName.description: The name the console shows and the audit log records. Theirs to change.

email.description:
The sign-in address. Fixed: it is `PlatformAdmin:Email` in configuration, and the seed finds the
account by it, so there is no endpoint that changes it.

Yalla.Application.Platform.PlatformAdmin.description: The signed-in platform admin's own account.

venues.description: How many venues there are, by tier and by state.

bookings.description: Bookings per day for the last 30 days and the week-on-week change.

pendingApprovals.description: Booking requests still waiting for a venue to approve them, per venue.

openTabs.description: Tabs open or closing right now, per venue.

notReady.description: Branches diners can reach that a guest would find unfinished.

recentVenues.description: The five newest venues that are not deleted, newest first.

outbox.description: The message outbox's counts - the same numbers `GET /api/platform/outbox` serves.

Yalla.Application.Platform.PlatformOverv.description: Everything the platform console's Home shows, in one read. Aggregates only: no guest's name, phone or booking code is in it, at any depth.

type.description: What kind of place a venue is. Drives the shipped reservation-policy defaults.

status.description: A venue's state, as one value. Derived from the venue's flags; never stored.

Yalla.Application.Platform.RecentVenue.description: A recently added venue, as Home's table shows it.

Yalla.Application.Platform.UpdateBranchC.description: Patch a branch. Every field optional; only the ones supplied change. Coordinates and address travel together.

Yalla.Application.Platform.UpdateVenueCo.description: Patch a venue. Every field optional; only the ones supplied change.

byWeekday.description:
All seven days, Sunday (0) to Saturday (6) as System.DayOfWeek numbers, by the weekday
of the visit at the branch.

averagePartySize.description: The average party of the bookings not cancelled, to one decimal; absent with none.

byBranch.description: Every branch of the venue, by name, each listed even with none.

Yalla.Application.Platform.VenueBookings.description: One venue's bookings over the last 7 or 30 days, as counts, for the venue page. Aggregates only: no guest's name, phone or code.

features.description: The features the platform allows there, in numeric order. Set with `PUT /api/platform/branches/{id}/features`.

isActive.description: Whether the branch is switched on.

issues.description:
What a guest would find missing at the branch, in checklist order: `no-tables`, `no-menu`,
`incomplete-dishes` (with `count`), `no-hours`, then `no-photo`. Empty when there
is nothing to do. Always empty for a deleted venue, which is not worked out. The full checklist is
`GET /api/branches/{id}/readiness`.

district.description: The branch's district as the listing form saved it; absent when it has none.

Yalla.Application.Platform.VenueBranchVi.description: One branch's features and what it still lacks, as the venue list shows it.

venue.description: One venue as the platform sees it, with its branches' rollups.

code.description: `no-tables`, `no-menu`, `incomplete-dishes`, `no-hours` or `no-photo`.

Yalla.Application.Platform.VenueReadines.description: The one issue the venue table shows, and the branch it is at.

Yalla.Application.Platform.VenueStatus.description:
A venue's state, as one value. Derived from the venue's flags; never stored.

Values: 1 Active, 2 Suspended, 3 Inactive, 4 Deleted.

type.description: What kind of place a venue is. Drives the shipped reservation-policy defaults.

slug.description: Unique URL segment for the brand.

isActive.description: Whether the venue is switched on at all.

isSuspended.description: Suspended venues keep every row but disappear from diner browsing.

isDeleted.description: Soft-deleted. Never a hard delete; the venue refuses every change.

suspendedAtUtc.description: When it was suspended, if it is.

deletedAtUtc.description: When it was deleted, if it was. Never cleared.

tableCount.description: How many active tables across all of them. A table kept only for its history is not one the room has, the same rule the readiness checklist counts by.

status.description:
The four booleans above as one value: 4 Deleted, else 2 Suspended, else 3 Inactive (switched off),
else 1 Active.

branches.description: Every branch with the features the platform allows there, active ones first, then by name.

averageRating.description:
The average of the published reviews across every branch, to one decimal; absent with none. The
same rule the public pages use, over the whole venue.

openTabCount.description: Tabs open or closing right now, across every branch.

readinessIssue.description:
The first thing a guest would find missing at the first branch that has one, in the order of
Branches - with that branch's name - or absent when nothing is. Codes:
`no-tables`, `no-menu`, `incomplete-dishes` (with `count`), `no-hours`,
`no-photo`. Never set for a deleted venue.

notReadyBranchCount.description: How many branches have at least one such issue.

coverThumbnailUrl.description:
The thumbnail of the first branch's cover photo, in the order of Branches:
root-relative (`/api/photos/{id}/thumbnail`) for an uploaded photo, absolute for a migrated
one. Absent when no branch has a cover.

district.description: The first branch's district, as the listing form saved it.

cuisine.description: The first branch's cuisine, as the listing form saved it.

Yalla.Application.Platform.VenueSummary.description: One venue as the platform sees it, with its branches' rollups.

count.description: Bookings whose visit fell on that weekday.

venueName.description: The venue, as the confirmation names it.

venueSlug.description:
The venue's half of the branch's public address, `/{venueSlug}/{branchSlug}`. The link a reminder
carries is `/booking/{token}`, with no branch in it, so the page needs these to link back to
the branch's page and open the booking card there. Public already: the address is the page's.

branchSlug.description: The branch's half of that address.

timeZoneId.description:
The branch's IANA zone. Every time here is wall-clock in it, and a diner reading this on a
phone set to another zone must not be shown a converted time.

tableLabel.description: The table, as printed on the floor.

localDate.description: The booked date, as the diner reads it off the confirmation.

status.description: Lifecycle of a booking. Every member is the result of somebody doing something.

code.description: The short code quoted at the door.

reservationId.description:
The booking's id - for one thing: the page that changes the booking sends it as
`excludeReservationId` on the branch's public availability and day-slot reads, so the table
the visitor already holds reads as free to them, as the app's change screen does. It opens nothing:
every route keyed by a booking id wants the booking's diner or the venue's staff, and the reads that
take it say no more about it than that its table is free.

tableId.description:
The booked table's id - so the change screen can start from the table the booking holds, and send it
back as `diningTableId` when only the time or the party changes. Table ids are no secret: the
branch's public availability and room photos publish them for every pinned table. The booked one is
named even if it has since been unpinned or taken out, which those reads do not list; a move to it is
then refused as for any table that cannot be booked.

cancellationDeadlineUtc.description:
The instant past which cancelling is recorded as late. Absolute rather than a number of minutes
so the page does not have to reimplement the arithmetic, and so a policy edit cannot silently
move a deadline the diner has already been shown.

canCancel.description: Whether cancelling would do anything - false once the booking is already cancelled, missed or finished. Not the deadline: cancelling past the deadline is allowed and merely recorded.

cancelledAfterDeadline.description: Whether this booking's cancellation, if it has one, arrived past the deadline.

awaitsEarlierGuestAnswer.description:
True while the booking waits on the guest before it on the table to answer in the app - only they can,
and the venue cannot decide it meanwhile - and false otherwise, a wait the venue decides after calling
them included. Both count down to ApprovalExpiresAtUtc; this says whose answer the
page is waiting for.

note.description:
The note the diner typed for the venue when booking, or absent (K9). Theirs to see again; it
says nothing the link holder did not write.

roomName.description:
The room the table is in - "Hall", "Terrace" - or absent for a table in no room. Said beside the
table label, because "table 4" alone does not tell somebody arriving which room to walk into.

approvalExpiresAtUtc.description:
For a booking waiting on a short-notice decision or on the guest before it on the table, when the
chance to answer runs out - the page counts down to it and reads the link again until the booking is
decided. Null otherwise.

declinedBecause.description:
Why a booking that was waiting was declined - the venue said no, or nobody answered in time - so
the page can apologise for the right thing. Null for a booking that was not declined.

phoneUnverified.description:
True when the booking was made without a proved phone number. The venue may confirm it first, and it is
never changed from the link - cancelled and booked again instead.

canChange.description:
Whether `POST .../reschedule` would be considered at all: the booking is still to come, pending or
confirmed, and its account is live with a proved number. False otherwise - hide "Change".

cancelledBecause.description: Set when the platform cancelled it - 1, its guest was blocked for three no-shows in three days.

preOrder.description: The booking's pre-order, with its state. Absent when it has none.

preOrderEditableUntilUtc.description:
Until when a pre-order may be added or changed (two hours before the start). Present only where the branch takes
pre-orders and the booking is pending or confirmed and still to come.

guestConfirmedOnWayAtUtc.description: When the guest answered "Yes, on my way".

onYourWayAsked.description:
Ask "Are you on your way?" now: from 45 minutes before the start, for a confirmed booking whose pre-order is waiting
(not sent, not marked not coming, not cancelled) and whose guest has not answered.

guestRunningLateMinutes.description: "I'm running late": 10, 15 or 30 minutes, the guest's latest answer.

staffAskedOnMyWayAtUtc.description: When the venue last asked "are you coming?" from its tablet.

onMyWayOpensAtUtc.description: From when "on my way" and "running late" are taken: two hours before the start.

Yalla.Application.Public.PublicBookingVi.description: One booking as its manage link shows it, to somebody holding nothing but the link.

branchId.description: The id, for the menu and availability routes.

branchSlug.description: The other half of a printed link.

freeTableCount.description:
How many tables have nobody sitting at them right now, walk-in-only stools included - the same
tables the branch page's `tableCount` counts and its plan draws, so the two can never read
"3 of 2 free" and zero means every seat is taken. The one volatile number here, and the reason
the browse list is cached for seconds rather than minutes.

isOpenNow.description: Whether it is inside an opening block at this moment, in its own zone.

timeZoneId.description:
The branch's IANA zone, e.g. `Asia/Yerevan`. A slot a diner picks after browsing is a
wall-clock time at the branch, and a phone set to another zone has to render it in this one
rather than guess - the diner app guessed `Asia/Yerevan`, because this list is the only
public read in front of its venue and booking screens and it did not say.

Yalla.Application.Public.PublicBranchCar.description: One branch on the browse list.

listing.description: The card, exactly as the list serves it.

about.description: A paragraph from the venue, or absent.

specialDays.description:
Special opening days from the branch's service date (yesterday while last night's block still runs past
midnight) through 60 days after today, earliest first - each replaces that date's weekly hours. Always present,
often empty. The card's `isOpenNow` already reads them.

gallery.description: Pictures beyond the cover, in the venue's order.

acceptsWebBookings.description: Whether the public page offers booking: web bookings (2) is in `listing.features`.

acceptsAppBookings.description: Whether the diner app may book here: app bookings allowed by the platform, online bookings switched on and the reservation policy saved by somebody at the venue (K9) - app bookings (1) is in `listing.features`. False means hide the booking button.

recentReviews.description: The newest three published reviews, by when they were first written. The rest are paged on the reviews route.

ratingCounts.description: How many shown reviews gave each star, one star first: always five numbers, [1★, 2★, 3★, 4★, 5★], zeros included. Over the same reviews as `listing.rating` and `listing.reviewCount`, read live with them, so the five add up to the count. For the distribution bars.

rooms.description:
The rooms a diner picks from, each with its photos and the live pins on them - the same payload as
`GET /api/public/branches/{id}/rooms`.

takeaway.description:
Whether the place takes takeaway orders from the app, and its preparation time - the "Order to take away" button
and the info card. Whether it is open for takeaway right now is `GET /api/diner/branches/{branchId}/takeaway`.

asOfUtc.description: When the live half was read.

Yalla.Application.Public.PublicBranchDet.description: One branch's details screen: everything on the card, and the rest.

branchId.description: The branch id every other route takes. The app's `Place.id`.

venueSlug.description: The venue half of the public link.

venueName.description: The brand name, what the card is titled with.

venueType.description: What kind of place a venue is. Drives the shipped reservation-policy defaults.

cuisine.description: Free text from the venue, or absent when not set.

distanceKm.description: From the `lat`/`lng` the caller sent, to 0.1 km. Absent when none was sent.

isOpenNow.description: Inside an opening block now, in the branch's zone.

freeTableCount.description: Active tables with nobody at them.

rating.description: Average stars to one decimal; absent when nobody has reviewed it.

features.description: The features on here as a diner sees them, in numeric order: allowed by the platform and switched on by the venue where the venue has a switch - app bookings (1: online bookings on and a saved reservation policy), web bookings (2: online bookings on), pre-orders (3: accepted), takeaway (4: enabled), guest messages (6: guests may write); the rest (5 table service, 7 reviews, 8-10) as allowed. Hide what is not listed.

district.description:
The part of town, e.g. "Kentron" - what the app prints after the venue type and the cuisine. Free
text from the venue, or absent when not set. Search matches it.

Yalla.Application.Public.PublicBranchLis.description: One branch on the diner app's Explore list, search results and map.

title.description: Venue and branch, as one line.

description.description: What the venue is. Stable enough to cache.

imageUrl.description: The branch cover photo, or the venue's, or null.

canonicalPath.description: The path this branch lives at, for `og:url`.

Yalla.Application.Public.PublicBranchMet.description: What a link to this branch should look like when it is pasted into WhatsApp or Telegram.

venueSlug.description: The venue half of the link.

branchId.description: The id the menu and availability routes take.

venueType.description: What kind of place a venue is. Drives the shipped reservation-policy defaults.

address.description: Street address, as a person would read it.

timeZoneId.description:
The branch's IANA zone. Every time on this page is rendered in it - a tourist's phone is on the
wrong zone, and a tourist is a named primary user of this surface.

specialDays.description:
The special opening days from the branch's service date through 60 days after today, earliest first: holidays,
closures and different hours on one date, each replacing that date's weekly hours. Always present, often empty.
The service date is today - or yesterday while last night's block still runs past midnight, so at 01:00 on New
Year's Day the list starts with the Eve the branch is still open in. Today's hours are today's special day when
there is one, else the weekday's; IsOpenNow already reads them.

isOpenNow.description: Whether it is open at this moment, decided in the branch's own zone. This is the only "is it worth going" signal, and there is deliberately no second one. An earlier draft carried a `status` of Open/Closed beside it, which was computed from this field and therefore said nothing new under a name that implied venue lifecycle. A branch that is suspended, deleted or switched off never reaches this response at all - every query behind it filters those out and the route answers 404 - so "shut tonight" is this field being false, and "this venue is gone" is the 404. Two names for one fact is how a mapper picks the wrong one.

freeTableCount.description:
Tables with nobody at them right now, bookable or walk-in only, so it is always out of
TableCount and always the number of tables the plan draws with
`isFree` true.

tableCount.description:
How many tables there are - every table on the plan, bookable or not - so the count has a
denominator.

floorPlan.description: The rooms, in diner shape: each room with its photos, and the tables with their pins and whether each is free. No QR tokens and no staff state - see Yalla.Application.Public.PublicFloorTable.

phoneE164.description:
The branch's contact number in E.164, or null when nobody has supplied one. The only way a
diner on this page can ask about a high chair or a wheelchair ramp.

acceptsWebBookings.description: Whether this branch takes bookings from this page. False unless somebody switched it on - see Yalla.Domain.Venues.Branch.AcceptsWebBookings. When false the page shows the room, the menu and the hours and offers no booking, which is a perfectly good page.

bookingWindowDays.description: How many days ahead this branch takes bookings, which is the maximum of the date input.

policy.description: The reservation rules a diner needs, and only those - see Yalla.Application.Public.PublicReservationPolicy for what is deliberately withheld.

asOfUtc.description:
When the server read the live half of this page. FreeTableCount,
IsOpenNow and each table's `isFree` are true as of this instant and no
later; the rest is stable. The page shows the staleness rather than implying there is none,
because this link is cached for seconds and shared for days.

features.description: The features on here as a diner sees them, in numeric order: allowed by the platform and switched on by the venue where the venue has a switch - app bookings (1: online bookings on and a saved reservation policy), web bookings (2: online bookings on), pre-orders (3: accepted), takeaway (4: enabled), guest messages (6: guests may write); the rest (5 table service, 7 reviews, 8-10) as allowed. Hide what is not listed. Read live, like AcceptsWebBookings.

coverPhoto.description:
The venue card's picture, or null when the owner has not set one. Part of the cached plan, not
the live stitch: it changes once during onboarding, and a stale cover is not a claim about the
room.

acceptsAppBookings.description: Whether the diner app may book here: AcceptsWebBookingsand a reservation policy somebody at the venue has saved (K9). Read live, like AcceptsWebBookings.

venueBranchCount.description:
How many branches the venue's chooser (`GET /api/public/venues`) lists for this venue - its
branches that are switched on, this one included - so the page can say "All 3 branches" without
downloading every venue to count them. A branch switched off is not listed there and not counted here.
Read live, in the same query as AcceptsWebBookings. At least 1.

rooms.description: The rooms that have at least one photo, lowest `displayOrder` first.

Yalla.Application.Public.PublicBranchRoo.description: The rooms of one branch, with every pin's live state.

areas.description: The rooms, lowest `displayOrder` first, each with its photos in order.

tables.description: Every active table, pinned or not, so the page's free count is out of the whole branch.

Yalla.Application.Public.PublicFloorPlan.description: The rooms as a diner sees them: each with its photos, and every table with its pin.

areaName.description: Which room it is in, by name. Null for none.

isBookable.description: Whether a diner can book it: bookable and pinned on a room photo. A table with no pin is not offered to diners, so it reads false here however the venue set it.

isFree.description: Whether anybody is sitting at it right now.

photoId.description: The room photo it is pinned on, or null.

photoX.description: Where the pin sits on that photo, 0-1 across; null with no pin.

Yalla.Application.Public.PublicFloorTabl.description: One table on the public page.

turnTimeMinutes.description:
How long the table is held. The diner is told this before booking because it is the answer to
"can we linger?", and finding out at the table is worse.

minLeadMinutes.description: How far ahead a booking must be made, which is what greys out the next available slot.

cancellationDeadlineMinutes.description:
How long before the start a diner may still cancel freely. On the page because a deadline
nobody was told about is a deadline that produces no-shows rather than cancellations.

acceptsPreOrders.description:
Whether a booking here can carry a pre-order - dishes chosen ahead, editable until two hours before. Published:
it is an offer to the diner, like the turn time.

Yalla.Application.Public.PublicReservati.description: The reservation rules a diner needs in order to book, and nothing else.

rating.description: The average of the shown reviews, or absent with none.

ratingCounts.description: How many shown reviews gave each star, one star first: always five numbers, [1★, 2★, 3★, 4★, 5★], zeros included - the whole branch's, not this page's. Over the same reviews as Rating and ReviewCount, so the five add up to the count.

Yalla.Application.Public.PublicReviewPag.description: A page of a branch's published reviews, newest first by when each was written.

authorName.description:
"Anahit S." - a first name and an initial, "Yalla diner" when the name cannot be shown. Never the
full name, a number, an email or any id. See `BranchReview.PublicAuthorName`.

text.description: Absent when the diner left stars only.

createdAtUtc.description: First written. The list is ordered by this, newest first.

updatedAtUtc.description: When the rating or text last changed.

edited.description: Whether it was changed after it was first written.

reply.description:
The venue's public reply under it, or null, signed with the writer's first name and surname initial.
Only shown reviews are listed, so a hidden review's reply is never public either.

photos.description: Its photos, in the order the venue chose. Never empty: a room with no photo is not listed.

Yalla.Application.Public.PublicRoom.description: A room a diner can pick: its photos in order, each with its live pins.

tables.description: The active tables pinned on it, by label.

Yalla.Application.Public.PublicRoomPhoto.description: One photo of a room, and the tables pinned on it.

tableId.description: The table id the booking flow takes.

seats.description: How many it seats. There is no minimum party size in the model.

isBookable.description: False for walk-in-only seats, which are pinned so a diner can see them but not booked.

state.description:
What a client should draw for a table: its physical Yalla.Domain.Enums.TableStatus with the
reservation overlay applied.

Yalla.Application.Public.PublicTableMark.description: One table's pin on a room photo, with its live state.

enabled.description: The venue takes takeaway orders from the app: allowed by the platform and switched on by the venue.

Yalla.Application.Public.PublicTakeawayI.description: A place's takeaway, as the place page shows it.

venueSlug.description: The public identity. Half of a printed link.

type.description: What kind of place a venue is. Drives the shipped reservation-policy defaults.

Yalla.Application.Public.PublicVenueCard.description: One venue on the browse list, with its branches.

reason.description: What the manager typed.

kind.description: Why money is coming off a bill.

previous.description: The same measure over the equivalent period immediately before. Null when there is no prior data at all - which is not the same as zero, and a client must render it differently: a venue's first week has no previous week, and "down 100%" would be a lie about it.

changeFraction.description: The change as a fraction, or null when there is nothing to compare against.

Yalla.Application.Reports.Compared.description: One number, beside what it was over the previous equivalent period.

revenueAmd.description: Taken that day, in whole dram: the hall's closed tabs and the takeaway orders collected.

takeawayAmd.description: Of RevenueAmd, taken for takeaway orders collected that day.

takeawayOrders.description: How many takeaway orders were collected.

upToMinutes.description: The top of this bucket, in minutes. The last one is open-ended.

sessions.description: How many sittings fell in it.
Sittings that were in progress during that hour.

revenueAmd.description: Taken in that hour, in whole dram - a tab at its close, a takeaway order when collected.

upToHours.description: Top of this bucket, in hours before the sitting.

bookings.description: How many were made that far ahead.

name.description: Its name now, not the snapshot on the line.

categoryName.description: Which section of the menu it sits in.

topByRevenue.description: Most valuable, which is frequently a different list.

neverOrdered.description: The report that changes behaviour. Items with no line in the period at all. A dish nobody orders is inventory that spoils and menu space that could sell something else, and no venue knows which those are - they are, by definition, the ones nobody mentions.

voids.description: Voided lines by item and reason. A dish voided often is mis-described or badly made.

sessions.description: Sittings that started in the period.

byHour.description: In progress by local hour of day.

seatsAvailable.description: Seats the room has, times the days in the period.

walkIns.description: Sittings with no booking behind them.

walkInGuests.description:
People at the sittings with no booking behind them - the walk-in half of the console's people split, which is
about guests, not tables: a walk-in couple and a booked party of eight are one sitting each.

reservationGuests.description: People at the sittings seated against a booking.

turnsPerTable.description:
Sittings per active table per day, to two decimals - the "table turnover" card. The previous period is divided
by today's table count too: the tables a branch had last month are not kept, and the card compares use, not
furniture.

activeTables.description: The active tables now, which TurnsPerTable divides by.

days.description: How many local days the range covers.

Yalla.Application.Reports.ReportRange.description: A date range in the branch's local dates, inclusive of both ends.

branchIds.description: One branch, or every branch of a venue for an owner's rollup.

timeZoneId.description: The zone the local dates were interpreted in.

Yalla.Application.Reports.ReportScope.description: Which branches a report covers, and over what.

booked.description: Bookings made for a sitting in the period.

seated.description: Those the party turned up for.

cancelled.description: Those called off by the guest or the venue - not the platform's (see SystemCancelled).

noShow.description: Those where grace ran out and the table was released.

noShowRate.description: No-shows over bookings. The number the whole reminder feature exists to move.

lateCancellations.description:
Called off inside the branch's own cancellation deadline. Distinguished from an ordinary
cancellation because a table given up in time is resold and one given up at 19:50 is not.

leadTime.description: How far ahead people book - what `BookingWindowDays` should be set from.

webBookingsWithoutAnApp.description: Booked from the public page by somebody with no registered device. These people cannot be reminded: no app means no push channel, so the reminder, the late nudge and one-tap cancel - the entire no-show story - do not reach them. This is the number that decides whether an SMS or Telegram channel is worth paying for. See `docs/reports.md`.

systemCancelled.description:
Cancelled by the platform, not the venue: the guest was blocked for three no-shows in three days elsewhere. Left
out of Cancelled, its rate and LateCancellations.

totalAmd.description:
Taken in the period: HallAmd + TakeawayAmd - the hall's closed tabs and the
takeaway orders collected at the counter.

serviceChargeAmd.description: Of which service charge (the hall's; a takeaway order has none).

averageTabAmd.description: Per tab - the hall's bills only.

averagePerHeadAmd.description: Per person on a tab. A different question from per tab, and the one a menu is priced against. The hall only: a takeaway order has no party.

byDay.description: Day by day, in local dates: every date of the range, zero days included.

byHour.description: Hour by hour, in local hours.

cashAmd.description: Taken in cash: at the hall's tabs and at the takeaway counter.

inAppAmd.description: Taken in the app. Zero until there is a wallet rail; the column is here so the day it exists nothing has to change.

adjustments.description: Comps and discounts, with who authorised them.

previousByDay.description:
The previous equivalent period, day by day - the chart's dashed line. Like ByDay it has one entry
for every local date of its period, zero days included, so the two have the same length and pair by index.

cardAmd.description:
Taken by card at the venue's own terminal - the takeaway counter's card payments (a tab's are not recorded by
method yet, and anything not cash on a tab is InAppAmd). Cash + card + in-app is the total.

hallAmd.description: Taken at the hall's tabs - the "Hall" half of the split; its count is Tabs.

takeawayAmd.description: Taken for takeaway orders collected in the period, at the counter - the "Takeaway" half.

takeawayOrders.description: Takeaway orders collected in the period.

takeawayNotCollected.description:
Takeaway orders the venue made and nobody came for (marked not collected in the period). No money: nothing is
charged in the app.

ordersEntered.description: Orders keyed in by staff, across the branch.

activeStaff.description: How many people worked the period.

Yalla.Application.Reports.StaffReport.description: What the venue needs to run the floor, and nothing more.

medianMinutes.description: The middle sitting. Null when nothing closed in the period.

p90Minutes.description: Nine sittings in ten finish inside this.

buckets.description: The whole shape, so the tail is visible rather than summarised away.

overPolicyFraction.description:
The fraction of sittings that ran past the policy's turn time. The single number to put next to
the chart, and the one that says whether the policy needs changing.

closedSessions.description: How many sittings the distribution was computed from.

Yalla.Application.Reports.TurnTimeDistri.description: How long parties actually stay, against what the policy assumes.

reason.description: Why it was taken off, in the waiter's words.

sessions.description: Sittings that started on that weekday.

nextAskAllowedAtUtc.description: When the venue may ask again, fifteen minutes on, if the guest has not answered.

notified.description:
The guest was sent the push and the feed entry. False for a booking with no live account behind it (made on the web
without one, or the account deleted): call the number instead.

Yalla.Application.Reservations.AskOnMyWa.description: The answer to the venue's "Ask: are you coming?".

reservation.description: The booking, as every client sees it - code, start, party, table, room, guest.

approvalExpiresAtUtc.description:
When the chance to answer runs out - fifteen minutes at short notice, two hours for a booking
waiting on the guest before it (Yalla.Application.Reservations.AwaitingApproval.Trigger 5) - or null for a booking with no deadline,
which waits for the venue as long as it takes (a large party next week, a branch that approves
every booking).

trigger.description: Why a booking needs a human before it is promised.

previousBooking.description:
The booking before this one on the same table that day - still to come, sitting there, gone
home or never turned up - or null when there is none. Cancelled bookings are not counted.

nextBooking.description: The next booking after this one on the same table that day, or null when there is none.

currentSitting.description: The party sitting at the table right now, or null when nobody is.

earlierGuestFreeByUtc.description:
The time the guest of Yalla.Application.Reservations.AwaitingApproval.PreviousBooking is asked to have left by for this booking -
its start less the clearing time - when saying yes means holding them to it; null when nobody
before has to be asked.

Yalla.Application.Reservations.AwaitingA.description:
One booking waiting for the floor to say yes or no, with what the floor needs to know about its
table to decide.

seatedAtUtc.description: Since when they have been sitting there.

partySize.description:
How many, when a waiter seated them or they came on a booking; null when a diner's scan opened the
table, which only guesses.

Yalla.Application.Reservations.AwaitingC.description: The party at the table of a booking awaiting approval, right now.

localStartTime.description: When it starts, on the branch's wall clock.

promisedFreeByUtc.description: The time its guest promised to have left by, or null.

Yalla.Application.Reservations.AwaitingN.description: The booking after one awaiting approval, on its table, that day.

localStartTime.description: When it starts, on the branch's wall clock.

guestPhone.description:
Their number, E.164, so the floor can call and ask how long they will be. Null for a platform
admin reading the list.

status.description: Lifecycle of a booking. Every member is the result of somebody doing something.

promisedFreeByUtc.description: The time its guest already promised to have left by, or null - see `ReservationView.PromisedFreeByUtc`.

Yalla.Application.Reservations.AwaitingP.description: The booking before one awaiting approval, on its table, that day.

dinerDisplayName.description: Its display name, when it has one.

phoneE164.description: The proved number the block also holds, while it holds one.

blockedUntilUtc.description: When it ends on its own.

liftedBecause.description: Why: 1 a platform admin, 2 a no-show withdrawn.

Yalla.Application.Reservations.BookingBl.description: One no-show block as the platform console shows it.

timeZoneId.description: IANA zone, so a client can render the UTC instants below in local time itself.

localDate.description: The local date asked about, as the diner picked it.

requestedStartUtc.description: The requested slot as an instant.

requestedEndUtc.description:
The requested slot's end: start plus the branch's turn time. The diner is never asked how
long they intend to stay.

turnTimeMinutes.description: The branch's turn time, so a client can explain the window it is being shown.

bufferMinutes.description: The branch's clearing time between sittings.

cancellationDeadlineMinutes.description:
How long before the start a diner may still cancel freely - the branch's setting as it stands
now, which is what a cancellation is judged against.

cancellationDeadlineUtc.description:
The instant past which cancelling the slot asked about is recorded as late: the requested
start less Yalla.Application.Reservations.BranchAvailability.CancellationDeadlineMinutes.

unavailableReason.description:
A rule that refused the whole request before any table was considered - the date is too far
out, the slot is too soon, the branch is shut. Null when the request itself was fine.

asOfUtc.description: The instant these answers were computed for.

Yalla.Application.Reservations.BranchAva.description: Every table in a branch, answered for one requested slot, in one round trip.

date.description: The local date asked about, as `YYYY-MM-DD`.

stepMinutes.description: Minutes between listed start times. Always Yalla.Application.Reservations.DaySlotStep.Minutes - fifteen.

unavailableReason.description:
Why the whole day is refused, when it is: the branch is shut all day
(`OutsideOpeningHours`, and no slots), the day is past or every time left today is too
soon (`LeadTimeTooShort`), or it is further out than the branch books
(`OutsideBookingWindow`). Null when at least one time could be judged on its tables.

specialDay.description:
The date's special opening day - a holiday, a closure, different hours - when it is one; absent on an
ordinary day. The slots already follow it: a closed one lists no times of its own.

slots.description:
Every start time on the day whose whole sitting fits one opening block, earliest first. A time
the branch is shut for is left out rather than struck - it was never on offer.

Yalla.Application.Reservations.BranchDay.description: One day at a branch, answered every quarter of an hour: which start times have a table for this party.

time.description: The local wall-clock start, `HH:mm` - what the chip says.

startUtc.description: The same start as an instant.

isAvailable.description:
Whether at least one table can be booked for this party at this time: a bookable table pinned
on a photo of its room that seats them, within the branch's seat-overhang limit, that the
table's evening allows - free outright (Yalla.Application.Reservations.DaySlot.FreeTableCount), or once the guest before
agrees to leave in time (Yalla.Application.Reservations.DaySlot.RequestableTableCount).

isRequestable.description:
True when the only tables at this time are ones the guest before has to agree to free first:
show the time as available, labelled "the guest before you will be asked" (or, tonight, the
floor's short-notice wait). Yalla.Application.Reservations.DaySlot.RequiresApproval is true with it.

requestableTableCount.description: How many tables at this time can be had once the guest before agrees to leave in time.

mustFreeByUtc.description:
When every table on offer at this time has to be free again before a full sitting is over -
another booking follows it - the latest of those times; absent when at least one table gives a
full sitting. "Until 21:25". The table the diner picks says its own, which they accept before
booking.

requiresApproval.description:
True when a booking made at this time will land waiting for approval: the time is at short
notice (today at the branch, or under six hours away - the floor decides, within fifteen
minutes), the branch approves every booking by hand, or the party is over its threshold. Asked
per time, so on tomorrow's picker the first few hours can say yes and the evening no. The same
answer every table in the single-slot read gives.

freeTableCount.description:
How many tables the single-slot read offers at this time with nobody to ask first. Zero when
struck, and when the only tables are requestable ones.

unavailableReason.description:
Why nothing is free, when nothing is. `LeadTimeTooShort` or `OutsideBookingWindow`
when the time itself is refused; otherwise the tables' reason - when tables that fit the party
are taken, the commonest of `TableAlreadyBooked`, `TableCurrentlyOccupied`,
`TableJustBooked`, `NextBookingTooSoon` and `EarlierGuestBeingAsked`; else the
commonest reason across the tables, e.g. `PartyExceedsCapacity` when no table seats them.
Null when available.

Yalla.Application.Reservations.DaySlot.description: One start time on the day, and whether a table is free for it.

code.description: Its door code.

tableLabel.description: The table, as printed on it.

roomName.description: The table's room. Absent when none.

localStartTime.description: The same, on the branch's wall clock.

status.description: Lifecycle of a booking. Every member is the result of somebody doing something.

guestPhone.description: Their number, to call. Empty for a platform admin: the venue's to call.

guestConfirmedOnWayAtUtc.description: "Yes, on my way" - no need to call. Absent until they say it.

guestRecord.description: The guest's record, under the console list's rule. Absent where not shown.

sentByName.description: The waiter who sent it, as the PIN roster names them. Absent until sent.

notComingByName.description: The waiter who marked the party not coming. Absent unless marked.

tabId.description: The party's tab, once it is an order on it.

guestRunningLateMinutes.description: "Running late": 10, 15 or 30 minutes, the guest's latest answer. Absent unless they said it.

staffAskedOnMyWayAtUtc.description: When somebody at the venue last asked "are you coming?" from the tablet. Absent until asked.

wasReplay.description: On an action's answer: it had been done already, and nothing changed this time.

Yalla.Application.Reservations.DuePreOrd.description: One card on the floor tablet's pre-order rail - and the answer to the waiter's two actions.

items.description: The cards due now, soonest first.

nextDueAtUtc.description: When the next card will appear - read the rail again then. Absent when no other booking with a pre-order is coming.

holdExpiresAtUtc.description: Until when the table is now held.

extensionMinutes.description: How long was added, from the branch's policy.

extensionsRemaining.description:
Always zero after a successful extension. Stated so the app can grey the button out rather than
letting the diner tap it and be told no.

wasReplay.description: True when this command had already been applied.

booked.description:
Bookings whose time came, exactly Came + NoShows +
LateCancellations + Unmarked. A venue's cancellation or decline (or the
platform's), a cancellation in good time and a booking still waiting for the venue are not counted at all.

came.description:
Visits the venue vouched for: a waiter seated the party, or the sitting had an order sent to the kitchen or a
payment (review S1). Opening a tab from the booking code alone never counts.

noShows.description: Marked as not having come (and not withdrawn).

lateCancellations.description:
Cancelled by the guest after the venue's deadline, when the booking was confirmed and had been made before that
deadline (review S2).

unmarked.description:
Bookings whose time came and went with nobody on the floor settling them (review S5): confirmed and past their end
with nobody seating or marking them, or opened only from the booking code with nothing ordered or paid. Neither a
visit nor a no-show - most often a venue that does not seat guests in Yalla.

isNewGuest.description: Nothing booked in the window: show a neutral "new guest", never a warning.

takeawayNoShows.description:
Takeaway orders the guest's account placed whose promised ready time is in the window, made ready by the venue and
never collected (`TakeawayStatus.NoShow`). Counted apart from the bookings - none of the booking counts above
includes one, and IsNewGuest is about bookings only - but each counts toward the no-show block
like a booking's no-show (Yalla.Domain.Occupancy.NoShowBlockRules). See `docs/takeaway.md`.

blockedUntilUtc.description:
While the guest is blocked from booking for no-shows (Yalla.Domain.Occupancy.NoShowBlockRules): when the
block ends. Absent otherwise.

Yalla.Application.Reservations.GuestReco.description:
How a guest has kept their bookings over the last twelve months, at every venue - what a venue sees beside a
booking before it decides, and what the guest sees of themselves.

requestId.description: The request, to answer it by.

requestedStartUtc.description: When the later guest would sit down - "someone would like your table at 19:45".

freeByUtc.description: The time this guest is asked to have left by - "will you have left by 19:40?".

expiresAtUtc.description: The deadline to answer by. Past it the request lapses and this booking is unchanged.

requestedLocalTime.description: RequestedStartUtc on the branch's wall clock.

freeByLocalTime.description: FreeByUtc on the branch's wall clock.

Yalla.Application.Reservations.IncomingT.description: A later guest's request for a booking's table, as the booking's own guest is shown it.

upcoming.description: Bookings that have not finished yet, soonest first.

past.description: Everything else - completed, cancelled, missed - most recent first.

guestRecord.description: The diner's own record over the last twelve months - what venues see beside their bookings. Always present.

Yalla.Application.Reservations.MyReserva.description: A diner's own bookings, split the way the app shows them.

guestConfirmedOnWayAtUtc.description: When the guest first said so.

wasReplay.description: They had said so already; this changed nothing.

Yalla.Application.Reservations.OnMyWayRe.description: The answer to "Yes, on my way".

name.description: Its name when it was ordered.

note.description: For the kitchen. Absent when none.

availableNow.description:
False when the dish has since sold out, been excluded from pre-orders or left the menu. It stays on the pre-order -
it was promised - but a save that keeps it is refused.

preOrder.description: The pre-order as it stands. Absent after clearing.

wasReplay.description: The same command arrived before; nothing changed this time.

Yalla.Application.Reservations.PreOrderR.description: The answer to saving or clearing a pre-order.

Yalla.Application.Reservations.PreOrderS.description: The settings with the bounds and the product's fixed numbers, for the console's form.

id.description: The pre-order - and its kitchen ticket, and the order on the party's tab it becomes.

state.description:
Where a pre-order stands, as every read says it. Persisted nowhere - derived by M:Yalla.Domain.Occupancy.PreOrderRules.StateOf(Yalla.Domain.Enums.ReservationStatus,System.DateTime,System.Boolean,System.Boolean,System.DateTime) -
but pinned like every wire enum.

lines.description: The dishes, as the guest listed them, at their locked prices.

note.description: The booking-level note. Absent when none.

totalAmd.description: The lines at their locked prices. No service charge: that is the tab's.

editableUntilUtc.description: Two hours before the start: the guest may change it until then.

dueAtUtc.description: When the waiter's card appears: the branch's minutes before the start.

sentAtUtc.description: When a waiter sent it to the kitchen. Absent until then.

kitchenStatus.description:
Where its ticket is on the kitchen rail once sent (2 InKitchen, 3 Ready, 4 Served, 5 Voided) - the held ticket's
until the party sits, then the tab order's.

onTab.description: It is an order on the party's tab.

notComingAtUtc.description: A waiter marked the party "not coming / no answer".

Yalla.Application.Reservations.PreOrderV.description: A booking's pre-order, as every read gives it - the guest's, the waiter's and the console's alike.

Yalla.Application.Reservations.ReleaseOu.description:
Why a booking was let go, and whether it counts against the diner.

Values: 1 NoShow, 2 CancelledByVenue.

reservation.description: The booking in its new state.

tableFreed.description:
True when the table was held for this booking and has been freed. False when somebody else is
