sitting there - the release still stands, and the floor is left telling the truth.

tableId.description: The table this booking was for.

tableLabel.description: Its label, for the confirmation the waiter sees.

tableStatus.description: The physical state of a table: what somebody did to it.

countsTowardNoShowThreshold.description:
Whether this one goes on the diner's record. Stated in the response so a client can say so
rather than the waiter having to remember which button does what.

wasReplay.description: True when the booking had already been released and this is that answer.

guestBlockedUntilUtc.description:
Set when this no-show blocked the guest from booking (three in three days): until when - so the floor can tell
the waiter at once. Absent otherwise, and repeated on a replay of that no-show.

code.description: The short code the diner quotes at the door.

roomId.description:
The room the table is in - its `FloorArea`, the room a diner picked it from - or absent for
a table in no room.

roomName.description: The room's name - "Hall", "Terrace" - or absent with Yalla.Application.Reservations.ReservationView.RoomId.

endUtc.description: Start plus the branch's turn time, fixed when the booking was made.

localEndTime.description: Wall-clock end, derived from the stored interval for display.

promisedFreeByUtc.description: The time the guest promised to have left the table by, or absent.

incomingTableRequest.description:
Somebody would like this booking's table after it, and this guest is asked whether they will have
left in time - or absent. Only on the diner's own booking, only while the question is open.

status.description: Lifecycle of a booking. Every member is the result of somebody doing something.

phoneUnverified.description:
True when the booking was made without a proved phone number - only a booking made while Yalla#54's
unverified booking was live (2026-10-20): a web visitor who did not verify, or an app account whose number
was never proved. No booking is made that way any more; the flag stays as history, and staff show "number
not verified" beside such a booking while its account has still not proved its number.

guestRecord.description:
The guest's record over the last twelve months at every venue - on the venue's reads of a booking only
(the console's list, the floor's awaiting cards, the answers to approve and reject). Absent on every diner
and public read, and for a booking with no verified account behind it. See Yalla.Application.Reservations.GuestRecord.

note.description: The diner's note to the venue - "window table", "a high chair" - or absent (K9).

cancelledAfterDeadline.description:
Whether the cancellation came in past the branch's free-cancellation deadline. Recorded,
never punished here.

cancelledBecause.description:
Why the platform cancelled it, when neither the guest nor the venue did: 1 = the guest was blocked for
three no-shows in three days. Absent on every other booking. The status is then CancelledByVenue.

cancellationDeadlineUtc.description:
The instant past which cancelling is recorded as late: the start less the branch's
cancellation deadline as it stands, which is what a cancellation made now is judged against.
Cancelling after it is still allowed - recorded in Yalla.Application.Reservations.ReservationView.CancelledAfterDeadline, never
refused.

wasReplay.description: True when this booking already existed and was returned rather than created.

awaitingApprovalBecause.description: Why the booking is waiting for a human, when it is. Null for a confirmed booking.

approvalExpiresAtUtc.description:
When the chance to answer runs out, for a booking waiting on a short-notice decision or on the
guest before it on the table; null for every other booking, and once it is decided.

awaitsEarlierGuestAnswer.description:
True while the booking waits on the guest before it on the table to answer in the app - "will you
have left by 19:40?" - and false otherwise, the floor's own questions included.

declinedBecause.description:
Why a booking that was waiting was declined: a member of staff said no (1), nobody at the venue
answered in time (2), the guest with the table before said they would not have left in time (3),
or did not answer within the two hours (4). Null for every booking that was not declined - a venue
letting an accepted booking go is `CancelledByVenue` without one.

manageToken.description: The plaintext manage token, returned exactly once - in the response to the request that created this booking - and null on every later read.

preOrder.description:
The booking's pre-order, with its state (1 editable, 2 locked, 3 sent, 4 not coming, 5 cancelled). Absent when
it has none. On every read of a booking - the guest's, the floor's and the console's.

preOrderEditableUntilUtc.description:
Until when the guest may add or change a pre-order: two hours before the start. Present only where the branch
takes pre-orders and the booking is pending or confirmed and still to start - offer "Pre-order" while it is in
the future.

guestConfirmedOnWayAtUtc.description: When the guest answered "Yes, on my way". Absent until they do.

guestRunningLateMinutes.description: "I'm running late": 10, 15 or 30 minutes - the guest's latest answer. Absent unless they said it.

guestRunningLateAtUtc.description: When the guest said they are running late. Absent with Yalla.Application.Reservations.ReservationView.GuestRunningLateMinutes.

staffAskedOnMyWayAtUtc.description:
When somebody at the venue last asked "are you coming?" from the tablet. Set, and the guest has not answered, the
app shows "{venue} is asking: are you coming?". Absent until asked.

onMyWayOpensAtUtc.description:
From when "I'm coming" and "running late" are taken: two hours before the start. The answer is taken until the
booking ends, while it is confirmed.

messages.description:
The booking's thread with the venue in one line - the "Messages with the venue" card: unread, the last message,
whether it takes messages. On the guest's own reads (`getMyReservations`) only; absent elsewhere, and when the
booking has no thread and takes none. See `docs/messages.md`.

Yalla.Application.Reservations.Reservati.description: One booking as every client sees it.

guestRunningLateMinutes.description: 10, 15 or 30 - the answer as it now stands.

expectedArrivalUtc.description: The start plus the minutes: when the venue may expect them.

physicalStatus.description: The physical state of a table: what somebody did to it.

photoId.description:
The room photo the table is pinned on. Never null here: a table with no pin is not offered to
diners, so availability leaves it out.

photoX.description: Where the pin sits on Yalla.Application.Reservations.TableAvailability.PhotoId, 0-1 across.

photoY.description: Where the pin sits on Yalla.Application.Reservations.TableAvailability.PhotoId, 0-1 down.

state.description:
What a client should draw for a table: its physical Yalla.Domain.Enums.TableStatus with the
reservation overlay applied.

isAvailable.description: Whether this table can be booked for this party at this time.

unavailableReason.description: The one specific reason it cannot, when it cannot. Null when it can.

requiresApproval.description:
True when booking this table will land as `PendingApproval` rather than confirmed: the
slot is at short notice (today at the branch, or under six hours away - the floor decides,
within fifteen minutes), the branch approves every booking by hand, or the party is over its
threshold. Not a refusal, and worth saying before the diner commits.

isRequestable.description:
True when the table can be had only once the guest with it before agrees to leave in time: its
previous booking started less than three hours before (and at least ninety minutes - sooner is
refused, `TableJustBooked`). Available, labelled "the guest before you will be asked"; a
booking lands `PendingApproval` - `EarlierGuestConsent` on a later day, the floor's
short-notice decision tonight - so Yalla.Application.Reservations.TableAvailability.RequiresApproval is true too.

mustFreeByUtc.description:
The time a party booking this table now must have left by - the next booking's start less the
clearing time - when a full sitting would run into it; absent otherwise. The diner accepts it
before booking, by sending it as `acceptsFreeByUtc`.

mustFreeByLocal.description: Yalla.Application.Reservations.TableAvailability.MustFreeByUtc on the branch's wall clock - "will you free the table by 21:25?".

window.description: Start of the window on offer. The requested slot, when the table is available.

availableFromUtc.description: The start of the slot, which is what was asked for.

availableUntilUtc.description:
When the table has to be clear again - the next booking's start less the branch's clearing time.
Null when nothing is booked after it.

hasNoLaterBooking.description:
True when nothing is booked after this slot. Explicit, so a client never has to read a null as
either "unbounded" or "missing".

windowMinutes.description: How long the table is free for, in minutes. Null when unbounded.

isShorterThanTurnTime.description:
True when the window is shorter than the branch's usual sitting, so the client can say plainly
that this table gives less time than normal.

availableFromLocal.description: AvailableFromUtc as branch wall-clock time, for rendering.

Yalla.Application.Reservations.TableAvai.description: One table's answer for the requested slot: can the diner have it, and if so, for how long.

total.description: Rows across every page for this filter.

summary.description: The branch's numbers, independent of the filter and the page.

Yalla.Application.Reviews.ModeratedRevie.description: A page of a branch's reviews for moderation.

reported.description: Shown reviews with an open report - the `reported` filter's total.

visible.description: Shown, and so counted in the rating.

rating.description: The shown reviews' average to one decimal, as the public card shows it; null with none.

ratingChange30Days.description:
Today's rating of the shown reviews minus the same for the shown reviews older than 30 days, to one
decimal - rounded once, from the unrounded averages. Null when either side has no review.

distribution.description: Shown reviews per star, always five rows, 5 stars first.

Yalla.Application.Reviews.ModeratedRevie.description:
The whole branch's reviews in numbers, whatever the list's filter and page: the filter chips' counts,
the rating card and its change.

authorName.description: The public name, never the account's full name, number or email.

hiddenByPlatform.description:
Taken down by the platform rather than the venue. A venue cannot put these back; the console
shows them as the platform's decision.

reportCount.description:
How many diners reported it and nobody has dismissed. A platform admin dismissing the reports
(`POST /api/platform/reviews/{id}/dismiss-reports`) brings this to zero for both tiers; a report
filed after that counts again.

lastReportedAtUtc.description: The newest of those reports, or absent when there is none.

reply.description: The venue's public reply, or null. Shown here on hidden reviews too.

hiddenByName.description:
The full name of the venue staff member who took it down, read live. Null when it is shown, and when
the platform took it down - the console says "the Yalla team" and never names a platform admin.

Yalla.Application.Reviews.ModeratedRevie.description:
One review as a moderator sees it: the published fields, who wrote it, whether it is down and
why, and how often diners have reported it.

authorName.description:
"Aram H." - `BranchReview.PublicReplyAuthorName` of the writer's name as written. Absent when that
name looks like contact details and cannot be published; the role then signs the reply alone. The
console reads the full name.

authorRole.description: What a staff member is allowed to do, coarsely. Authorisation itself is a later task.

edited.description: Changed after it was first published.

Yalla.Application.Reviews.PublicReviewRe.description:
The venue's reply as the public reads it - the public reviews, the place's details and the author's own
review in the app. The writer is shown as diners are: first name and surname initial.

authorName.description: The full name of the staff member who last wrote it, as it was then.

authorRole.description: What a staff member is allowed to do, coarsely. Authorisation itself is a later task.

createdAtUtc.description: First published. A reply removed and written again starts over.

updatedAtUtc.description: When the text last changed; equal to CreatedAtUtc until an edit.

edited.description: Changed after it was first published.

Yalla.Application.Reviews.ReviewReplyVie.description:
The venue's public reply under a review, as every read shows it: the console, the public reviews,
the place's details and the author's own review.

count.description: Shown reviews with that many stars.

serviceDate.description:
"Today" at the branch: its own date, or yesterday while last night's opening block still runs past midnight - the
Overview's service day. The shift line reads the shifts dated this.

onShiftToday.description:
"On shift today: N people" - the active people with a working shift (not a day off) at this branch dated
ServiceDate.

shifts.description:
This branch's shifts dated From to To, active people only, by date, then
start (days off first), then person.

Yalla.Application.Staff.BranchShiftsView.description: A branch's shifts over a window, with what the Staff screen's header counts.

role.description: What a staff member is allowed to do, coarsely. Authorisation itself is a later task.

Yalla.Application.Staff.CreateStaffComma.description: A new staff member. A PIN is required; email and password are for owners and managers.

role.description: What a staff member is allowed to do, coarsely. Authorisation itself is a later task.

date.description: The branch's local date it starts on.

dayOff.description: A day off on the date; no times then.

startsAt.description: Wall clock; absent on a day off.

endsAt.description: Wall clock, on the next date when EndsNextDay; absent on a day off.

endsNextDay.description: Ends after midnight - including at exactly 00:00. False on a day off.

startsAtUtc.description: The start as an instant; absent on a day off.

endsAtUtc.description: The end as an instant; absent on a day off.

Yalla.Application.Staff.StaffShiftView.description: One shift as every read returns it.

resetLink.description: The link to hand over. Opening it is how they choose their password.

expiresAtUtc.description: When the link stops working unused.

replacedExistingSignIn.description:
True when this person already had a password. It keeps working until the link is used, at
which point it is replaced and every session they had open is ended.

Yalla.Application.Staff.StaffSignInLink.description:
A freshly issued sign-in link. ResetLink exists only here: the server keeps
the token's hash and no read ever returns it, so this is the one copy.

timeZoneId.description: The zone every local value is in.

asOfUtc.description: The instant it is true of.

serviceDate.description: The service day, as the Overview has it: today, or yesterday while last night's block runs.

branches.description: The branches the caller may switch to here, by name; this one among them.

shifts.description: Who works today: the service date's shifts at the branch, and last night's still running.

Yalla.Application.Staff.StaffToday.description:
The manager's "Today" on the staff phone: one branch's day so far in one read - takings, guests, bookings, the
room, what needs them, and who is on shift.

total.description: Every booking still on the books (not the cancelled or declined).

came.description: Seated now, or came and left.

expected.description: Confirmed and not yet seated, the late ones included.

late.description: Of Expected, those past their start.

pendingApproval.description: Requests still waiting for an answer.

Yalla.Application.Staff.TodayBookings.description: The service day's bookings, by what became of them - the Overview's counts.

Yalla.Application.Staff.TodayGuests.description: People seated since the day's takings started.

pendingApprovals.description: Bookings the floor can answer now - the awaiting list's rule, any day.

oldestApprovalRequestedAtUtc.description: When the longest-waiting of them was asked for; absent with none.

soonestApprovalDeadlineUtc.description: The nearest answer deadline among them; absent when none has one.

unansweredMessages.description: Open threads whose guest wrote and nobody at the venue answered since.

oldestUnansweredMessageAtUtc.description: When the longest-waiting of those guests wrote; absent with none.

Yalla.Application.Staff.TodayNeedsYou.description: What waits for somebody - the board's "needs you".

hallAmd.description: Tabs closed since the day's first opening - the Overview's revenue.

sinceUtc.description: Where the day's takings start: the first opening of the service date, or its midnight.

Yalla.Application.Staff.TodayRevenue.description: The service day's takings so far, in whole dram.

occupiedTables.description: Active tables somebody is sitting at.

tables.description: Active tables, out of service included.

role.description: What a staff member is allowed to do, coarsely. Authorisation itself is a later task.

endsAt.description: Branch wall clock, on the next date when EndsNextDay.

signedIn.description: Has a live PIN session on a device of this branch now - the board's "signed in".

Yalla.Application.Staff.TodayShift.description: One person's shift today at the branch.

Yalla.Application.Staff.UpdateStaffComma.description:
Patch a staff member. BranchId is applied only when SetBranch
is true, so that "make them venue-wide" (null) can be told apart from "leave it".

reservationId.description: The booking, so the waiter can release it from this screen.

code.description: The short code the diner quotes at the door.

guestPhone.description: What to call them on. This is the point of surfacing the list at all.

partySize.description: How many, so the waiter can look for another table that fits.

localDate.description: The booked date, as the diner sees it.

localStartTime.description: The booked time, as the diner sees it.

status.description: Lifecycle of a booking. Every member is the result of somebody doing something.

Yalla.Application.Tables.AffectedReserva.description: A booking left stranded by a table going out of service.

fromStatus.description: The physical state of a table: what somebody did to it.

toStatus.description: The physical state of a table: what somebody did to it.

state.description:
What a client should draw for a table: its physical Yalla.Domain.Enums.TableStatus with the
reservation overlay applied.

tableSessionId.description: The occupancy opened or closed by this change.

nextReservationStartUtc.description: Start of the next relevant booking, when there is one.

freeUntilUtc.description: When the table has to be clear again: the next booking's start less the branch buffer.

wasReplay.description:
True when this command had already been applied and the result was replayed from the audit
log rather than performed again. Callers can treat it exactly like a fresh success.

outstandingAmd.description: Money still owed, when the change left an unresolved tab behind.

affectedReservations.description: Bookings this table still has tonight, when it has just been marked out of service.

Yalla.Application.Tables.TableStateChang.description: The outcome of one table state change.

code.description: Stable slug clients branch on, e.g. `upcoming-reservation`.

message.description: Text for the waiter, e.g. `table 7 reserved 20:00`.

Yalla.Application.Tables.TableStateWarni.description: A warning that accompanies a successful transition.

token.description: The participant token. No account behind it - see `docs/auth.md`.

tab.description: The tab, projected through this participant's own permissions.

wasReplay.description:
True when the `clientCommandId` had already been applied and this is the original answer
again. Treat exactly like a fresh success.

Yalla.Application.Tabs.TabAccessResult.description:
What a scan or a join hands back: the device's tab-scoped token, the tab as this person is
allowed to see it, and which case they landed in.

lineId.description: The line it applies to, or null for one against the whole tab.

kind.description: Why money is coming off a bill.

percent.description: The percentage, when it is one.

amountAmd.description: The flat amount, when it is one.

reductionAmd.description: What it took off, in whole dram.

reason.description: What the manager typed.

isVoided.description: True once it was reversed. It stays on the record, marked.

Yalla.Application.Tabs.TabAdjustmentView.description: One comp or discount, as the diner sees it.

status.description: Whether the people on a tab may order yet.

admittedBecause.description:
1 a waiter admitted it, 2 the host's number is proved, 3 staff opened it, 4 the booker opened or joined it,
5 not required - the branch lets unverified scans order at once. Absent while waiting, once rejected, and
on tabs from before admission.

decidedAtUtc.description: When it was admitted or turned away; absent while waiting.

decidedByStaffId.description: The waiter who did, when one did.

tableFreed.description: On a rejected tab: whether turning it away freed the table (the scan had seated it).

Yalla.Application.Tabs.TabAdmissionView.description: Whether a tab may order yet: waiting for a waiter, admitted, or turned away. See `docs/tabs.md`.

tabId.description: The tab - admit or reject it.

roomName.description: The table's room, absent for a table in none.

hostDisplayName.description: What the host called themself, or the roster's placeholder.

participantCount.description: Phones on the tab, the host included; removed ones not.

sittingSeatedByScan.description:
True when the scan itself seated the table: rejecting then frees it. False when a waiter or a booking
seated the party - rejecting then closes only the tab, and the party can scan again.

Yalla.Application.Tabs.TabAwaitingAdmiss.description: One tab waiting for a waiter, as the tablet's rail draws it.

token.description: The opaque value. Render it as a QR on the host's screen.

shareUrl.description: The same token as a link, for WhatsApp or Telegram and the friend who is late.

expiresAtUtc.description: Thirty minutes from issue. The host refreshes by asking for another.

Yalla.Application.Tabs.TabJoinTokenResul.description: An invitation to a tab. One token, two ways to hand it over.

orderId.description: The order it was part of, so the client can group a round together.

menuItemId.description: The item, so the client can link back to the menu entry.

placedByParticipantId.description: Who ordered it from their phone. Null when a waiter keyed it in.

placedByDisplayName.description: Their name at the time of reading.

name.description: The item name as it read on the menu when ordered.

unitPriceAmd.description: Unit price in whole dram as it stood when ordered.

lineTotalAmd.description: Unit price times quantity, in whole dram. Zero once voided.

note.description: The kitchen note that was sent with it, e.g. "no onions".

orderStatus.description: Kitchen-facing progress of one order placed against a tab.

orderedAtUtc.description:
When it was ordered: the `placedAtUtc` of the order it came in on, so the bill can say who
and when under each dish ("Ani · 19:08"). Every line of a round shares it. A booking's pre-order
keeps the time the waiter sent it to the kitchen, not the time the party sat down. UTC; the
client shows it in the tab's `timeZoneId`.

isShared.description: True when the item belongs to the table and is split across those present.

sharedWithCount.description: How many people a shared line is split between. From the line's own participant snapshot, not the current roster: a friend who joined ten minutes after the bottle was poured is not on it, and a badge computed from the roster would silently re-split every existing line each time somebody else scanned the code.

isVoided.description: True once staff took it off the bill. The line stays here, labelled. It is excluded from every total, and a diner watching their bill must still see that the coffee was removed.

voidReason.description: Why, in the waiter's own words.

onBehalfOfParticipantId.description:
Who a waiter keyed this line in for, when the waiter knew: the guest named on the line itself, or
else the one named on its order. The line is that person's - on their `myLines` and their
share - though PlacedByParticipantId is null. Null on a shared or
table-attributed line, which is the table's whoever the order was for; one round can carry a
different guest on every line.

isTableAttributed.description:
True when a waiter keyed it in for nobody in particular. It splits across the people at the table
when it was ordered, exactly like a shared line, and SharedWithCount says how
many.

Yalla.Application.Tabs.TabLineView.description: One item on the tab, as snapshotted when it was ordered.

Yalla.Application.Tabs.TabOpenOutcome.description:
Which of the four table-state cases a scan landed in. See `docs/tabs.md`.

Values: 1 OpenedNewSession, 2 OpenedOnExistingSession, 3 JoinedExistingTab.

role.description: Whether a participant opened the tab or joined it.

status.description: Whether a participant is allowed on the tab.

photo.description:
Their diner account's profile picture, when they scanned signed in and have one. Absent
otherwise; draw initials. The URLs are relative to the API.

Yalla.Application.Tabs.TabParticipantSum.description: Who is at the table, as the other diners see them: a name, a face, and whether they are in yet.

displayName.description: What the host sees. The participant can change their own.

role.description: Whether a participant opened the tab or joined it.

status.description: Whether a participant is allowed on the tab.

canOrder.description: The stored flag: whether the host allows them to add items.

canSeeTableTotal.description: Whether they may see the table aggregate and other people's items.

canPay.description: Whether they may settle against the tab. Implies CanSeeTableTotal.

canOrderNow.description:
The flag applied to the moment: approved, allowed to order, the tab still open - and admitted: false for
everybody while the tab waits for a waiter. This is what the ordering endpoints enforce.

photo.description:
Their profile picture, when the phone that scanned was signed in to a diner account that has
one. Absent for a guest who scanned without an account - most of them - and for an account
since deleted. The URLs are relative to the API.

Yalla.Application.Tabs.TabParticipantVie.description: One person on a tab, with their flags. Not an account - see `docs/auth.md`.

status.description: Lifecycle of a tab.

settlementMode.description: How the people on a tab agreed to split the bill.

totals.description: The table aggregate, in whole dram. Server-computed; the client only displays it.

admission.description: Whether a tab may order yet: waiting for a waiter, admitted, or turned away. See `docs/tabs.md`.

Yalla.Application.Tabs.TabStaffView.description:
A tab as staff see it: every phone on the table, with roles and flags, and the money. Staff are
not participants and are not subject to the host's visibility flags.

Yalla.Application.Tabs.TabTotalsView.description: The table aggregate, in whole dram. Server-computed; the client only displays it.

venueName.description:

need not make a second, public read to say where it is.

branchName.description: The branch's name, for the same reason.

tableLabel.description: The table as printed on the floor, e.g. 7 or T12.

timeZoneId.description: The branch's IANA zone, e.g. `Asia/Yerevan`. Every time on this response is to be rendered in it, never in the device's. A tourist's phone is on the wrong zone, and a diner who has just landed is the exact person least able to work out the offset - and without this the client had to make a second call to a different endpoint to find out.

status.description: Lifecycle of a tab.

settlementMode.description: How the people on a tab agreed to split the bill.

hostParticipantId.description: Who hosts. Null on a tab staff opened that nobody has scanned onto yet.

serviceChargePercent.description: The branch's service charge as it stood when this tab opened, snapshotted onto the tab. Present for everyone, including a guest whose host has hidden the total: the percentage is a fact about the venue rather than an aggregate, and the bill has to state it from the first item. It was manager-only, sitting on the reservation policy behind `ManagerOrAbove`.

closedAtUtc.description: When it closed, if it has.

maxSequence.description:

without a second call to `/events` purely to ask.

me.description: The caller's own participant row, with every flag and whether they may order right now.

participants.description:

themself while they are pending, because a pending joiner may see their own state and nothing else.

myLines.description:
The caller's own items, always present: one they ordered, or a waiter keyed in on their behalf,
and a shared item they were at the table for - and a table-attributed line they were at the table
for only with TableTotalVisible, because those can be the whole bill. See
M:Yalla.Application.Tabs.TabProjection.IsOwnLine(Yalla.Application.Tabs.TabLineSnapshot,System.Guid,System.Boolean).

myItemsSubtotalAmd.description:
What the caller's own unsplit lines come to, in whole dram. Always present. Shared and
table-attributed lines on MyLines carry `isShared` or
`isTableAttributed` and are apportioned by `/shares`, not here.

adjustments.description: Comps and discounts, with the reason the manager typed, for the same reason voided lines are shown: a total that drops with no visible cause makes people distrust the app. Every one when TableTotalVisible; otherwise only those on one of MyLines, whole. One off the whole tab, or off somebody else's line, is table money - a percentage off the whole tab and what it took off are the subtotal - and the caller's part of it reaches them through `/shares`.

tableTotalVisible.description: Whether the three members below are present.

tableTotal.description: The table aggregate. Absent when not visible - never zero, never null-as-free.

tableLines.description: Every line on the tab with who placed it, voided ones included. Absent when the total is hidden.

admission.description:

true: show "a waiter will be with you", keep "call a waiter". See `docs/tabs.md` section 2b.

pickupAsap.description: Ordered for as soon as possible.
